auditSample.textSample: The Kaiser Wiesn is Vienna's Oktoberfest, and walking in is free. It takes over the Kaiserwiese in the Prater from 24 September to 11 October. That's 18 days, three festival tents, five alpine huts, and no gate ticket. You pay only for the evening shows in the tents. Which is why the afternoon is worth planning for. Music runs across the grounds from 12:15, brass bands included, so the Wiesn is already going by lunchtime. The Gösser tent has free entry from 13:00 to 17:00, the Wiesbauer from 12:00 to 17:30, and inside the benches fill slowly enough that you get the sound and still keep the conversation across the table. Hey ihr Lieben! Kennt ihr Wien und sogar vielleicht den Bezirk Hietzing? Heute nehme ich euch auf einen kleinen Spaziergang durch Hietzing mit bzw. einen kleinen Teil meines Heimat Bezirkes. Wunderschöne Gebäude, viel Grün, Schönbrunn, der Lainzer Tiergarten und viele tolle Einkaufsmöglichkeiten. Wir haben eine enorme Dichte an Cafés, kleinen Lokalen und tollen Geschäften. Shop local ❤️ Heute gab's... …”hallo” from grandiose Vienna!… hooray!… it’s the final destination of our Austrian train loop journey and I couldn’t be happier or more excited!… …Vienna is the most iconically chic European capital and a true aristocratic city!… the vibes are amazing at every step of the way, the weather is fantastic this time and the culinary scenery is awaiting, along with a few other activities on the way!… …my favourite lunch spot is the best choice for a traditional meal in the heart of it all!… lugeck_figlmueller is a great place to enjoy the obvious dishes with a chic twist!… …how about yet another schnitzel, but this time please make it gourmet!… loaded with local truffle shaved live at the table
